subject: Deal signal sweep + board narrative briefing
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Deal signal sweep + board narrative briefing

Team — quick ask to get the board packet numbers clean by EOD. We're running a short "deal signal sweep" to make sure ARR and bookings on the packet are defensible and traceable. Please treat as high priority.

What I'm asking for (short checklist):
- Stage hygiene: move any true-commit deals into the Commit stage and tag with a one-line rationale (sales motion + blocker cleared) — do not leave ambiguous "Commit?" stages.
- Close dates: pin final close date to the quarter shown. If still soft, move to Best Case and note probability.
- Activity gate: if there's no customer activity in 90+ days and no updated docs, archive to "Stale - remove from packet" (we'll keep in CRM but not the board numbers).
- Evidence: add a one-line evidence pointer in the deal notes (contract LOI, signed MSA, PO email, proof-of-concept acceptance).
- Narrative flags: for multi-year contracts, mark recognized ARR vs. deferred bookings and attach the one-paragraph accounting note.

Attachments: pipeline_export_q3.csv (attached) + draft board narrative in Drive (link below).
Deadline: stage updates + evidence pointers by 11:59 PT today. Final numeric reconciliation by 16:30 PT so we can bake into the packet.

I'll circulate an updated board_narrative_draft_v2.docx after reconciliation. If you expect any surprises (large churn, material revenue recognition edge cases), flag to me + Vivek immediately so we can prep the note for investors.

Thanks — Chloe
Chloe Martin
Head of Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference

Related links: https://drive.redwood.com/board/packet/2028Q3

- DEAL-4471 (SierraHealth) — health-check flag: invoice dispute on prior month; reopening pricing question; mark as Best Case until resolved.

I've uploaded a deal_journal_snapshot.xlsx with the three flagged rows and a notes column. Will push stage changes to CRM and add evidence links by 11:30. If anything moves to Stale I will leave a short rationale.

Agree with the approach. A couple of narrative asks for the board packet team (helps investor Q&A):
- For any multi-year deals, include a one-sentence breakdown: total contract value, recognized ARR this FY, and the deferred revenue policy we will apply.
- Where ARR is largely usage-based, add the baseline MRR and the ramp assumption for the quarter (conservative and stretch).
- If there are deals that require a credit or concession, note the concession type and amount estimate.

Operational: I'll take point on reconciling bookings vs. ARR in the packet (stateside and EMEA split). Grace — can you confirm the EMEA translations for PCC entries?

Appreciate the quick work. A couple of governance points before we lock:
- Any deals classed as Commit must have a single evidentiary pointer (signed doc, PO, or an email chain with procurement + finance). If we have a verbal-only commitment, classify as Best Case and note the probability.
- Material changes (> $250k ARR variance from last packet) require a one-paragraph explanation and the owner listed in the tracker. We'll surface those in the board appendix.

Chloe/Vanessa — once the recon is in, please send me the reconciled ARR/Bookings table and the redlines summary by 17:30 PT so I can approve the narrative. If we see anything that materially impacts guidance, I'll loop in legal and investor relations.

Thanks all — Vivek
